Study Advance in Anti-tumor Mechanisms of Polyphyllin
Lu Wei1 ，Pan Meng1 ，Yang Guangyi1 ，Zhang Chenning1 ，Hu Pei1 ( 1． Department of Pharmacy，2． Cardiovascular Department，Taihe Hospital Affiliated to Hubei University of Medicine，Hubei Shiyan 442000，China)ABSTRACT Paris polyphylla is the dried rhizome of P． polyphylla smith Var． yunnanensis ( Franch) Hand-Mazz or P． polyphylla smith Var． chinensis ( Franch) hara． Steroidal saponins are generally regarded as its main chemical and bioactive ingredients with promising therapeutic effect on cancer． The mechanism of those ingredients with strong antitumor activity includes inhibiting mitosis， inducing cell cycle stasis，inhibiting the expression of tumor gene or enhancing that of tumor suppressor gene，inhibiting the growth of tumor blood vessels and regulating immune function． They also can reverse the multi-drug resistance of tumor cells． The recent research advance in the antitumor mechanism of polyphyllin reviewed in this paper could provide reference for the further utilization of Paris polyphylla．重楼为百合科植物云南重楼 Paris polyphylla Smith Var．yunnanensis ( Franch． ) Hand-Mazz． 或七叶一枝花 Paris
